findings.title: Reader thread is never joined before asserting no exceptions occurred
findings.body: The test starts a reader thread but keeps no reference to it and never joins it. It only sets deletedAll=true after deleting the groups and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty, while the reader may still be inside managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...) and may record an exception after the assertion has run. The test can therefore pass despite the concurrent-access NPE occurring, and the unjoined thread can also continue issuing requests against the managed realm after the test method has finished. The thread should be retained and joined (with a timeout) after deletedAll is set and before the assertion.

findings.title: Other lazy-delegate dereferences still NPE when the group is deleted concurrently
findings.body: This change null-checks only getSubGroupsCount(), but the three getSubGroupsStream(...) overloads at lines 254-269 still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check. If another transaction deletes the group, modelSupplier.get() returns null in exactly the same way it does for getSubGroupsCount(), so these paths still throw NullPointerException instead of handling the deleted group. The same concurrent-deletion scenario exercised via subgroup listing/search can therefore still fail with an NPE; these dereferences need the same null handling (or a consistent contract) as getSubGroupsCount().
